identity.title: pi0.7: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
identity.repo_note: Physical-Intelligence/openpi documents pi0, pi0-FAST, and pi0.5. It does not contain pi0.7. That repository was not cloned as this paper's code.

distinct_from.name: Physical-Intelligence/openpi
distinct_from.why: Related earlier models. The README's model list stops at pi0.5.

summary: pi0.7 is a 5B flow-matching VLA, a Gemma3 4B backbone plus an 860M action expert, trained with a richer prompt than a task sentence: detailed language, episode metadata, control-modality labels, and multi-view subgoal images. A separate 14B BAGEL model generates those subgoals. The paper's claim is that this context lets the VLA train on mixed-quality and non-robot data without averaging incompatible strategies. There is no public implementation to link.

model.overview: Gemma3 4B VLM, including a 400M vision encoder, with a MEM-style video history encoder that emits a fixed token count for any history length. An 860M flow-matching action expert attends to the VLM. Knowledge insulation trains the VLM with FAST tokens and stops action-expert gradients from entering the VLM. The subgoal generator is a BAGEL 14B model, separate from the 5B policy.

total_params.value: About 5B: Gemma3 4B VLM (400M of that is the vision encoder) and an 860M action expert. The subgoal world model is a separate BAGEL 14B.

objectives.name: Steerable action likelihood
objectives.explanation: The written objective is a chunk log-likelihood conditioned on recent observations and the full context. The paper says the flow-matching expert optimizes a lower bound of that likelihood rather than the closed form. Context is what makes a failed episode usable: the metadata tells the model how the episode was performed.

symbols.meaning: Language, episode metadata, control modality, and subgoal images.
Action-chunk horizon. A shorter prefix is executed.

objectives.name: Subgoal flow matching
objectives.explanation: The world model is trained with conditional flow matching to the image at the end of a labeled segment. At runtime it fills in the subgoal images the VLA was trained to consume.

symbols.meaning: Observed frame at the end of the segment.

train.text: Initialize the VLM and vision encoder from Gemma3 and the subgoal model from BAGEL.
Supervise the VLM with FAST tokens. Train the action expert with flow matching and stop its gradients at the VLM.
Put language, metadata, control modality, and subgoal images in the prompt so mixed-quality episodes stay distinct modes.
Train the subgoal model with conditional flow matching on high-quality labeled segments, using the segment's final frame as the target.

infer.text: A high-level policy of the same architecture writes the subtask language.
The BAGEL world model writes multi-view subgoal images from that subtask, the observation, and metadata.
The 860M action expert flow-matches a chunk conditioned on history tokens and that context. Execute a prefix of the chunk.
